faqs.title: How much does custom software development cost?
faqs.summary: It depends on scope and complexity. After a short discovery call we give you a clear, itemized estimate — no vague packages. Small projects start low; larger systems are quoted per feature set.

faqs.title: How long does it take to build a website?
faqs.summary: A focused marketing website typically takes 2–4 weeks. Web applications and custom systems run longer depending on features. We share a realistic timeline before we start.

faqs.title: Do you build software for businesses in Egypt?
faqs.summary: Yes. We are based in Cairo and work with businesses across Egypt and internationally, both remotely and on-site where needed.

faqs.title: Can you build a custom POS system?
faqs.summary: Absolutely. POS, inventory, kitchen displays and management dashboards are a core specialty — built around how your business actually operates.

faqs.title: Do you develop mobile applications?
faqs.summary: Yes — modern cross-platform apps for iOS and Android, connected to secure backends and real-time data.

faqs.title: Can you maintain an existing website or software?
faqs.summary: Yes. We can audit, fix, extend and maintain existing projects, or take over a codebase from a previous team.

faqs.title: Can you integrate APIs and payment gateways?
faqs.summary: Yes. We integrate payment gateways, third-party APIs, messaging, maps and analytics as part of most projects.

faqs.title: Do you provide hosting and deployment?
faqs.summary: Yes. We handle deployment, hosting setup and monitoring, and can manage everything for you after launch.
